title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion in Berkshire shares to four charities, backs successor Greg Abel
summary_full: Warren Buffett has donated approximately $5.47 billion worth of Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charitable foundations associated with his three children. The 96-year-old billionaire also reiterated his confidence in successor Greg Abel, saying his faith in Berkshire Hathaway's new leadership remains as strong as ever. The donation takes his total charitable contributions beyond $29 billion.
